acquisition method: MS data were acquired with a shotgun proteomics method
cleavage agent: The first digestion was done at 37 °C for 2 h with LysC (1:50 enzyme to protein ratio)... The second digestion step was done using fresh LysC (1:50 enzyme to protein ratio) and trypsin (1:20 enzyme to protein ratio)
fractionation method: proteins were extracted from the insoluble pellet in three steps using buffers with increasing stringency using the QDSP protocol
fragmentation method: Precursors were fragmented by higher-energy collisional dissociation
instrument: Quadrupole/Orbitrap type Mass Spectrometer (Q-Exactive, Thermo Scientific)
labeling: For label-free quantification in MaxQuant the minimum ratio count was set to two.
